brief:
The Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft examined structural challenges facing major pro-Israel lobbying organizations in American politics. The analysis assessed whether established advocacy groups can sustain their historical influence amid shifting demographics, generational attitudes, and evolving political alignments.

The institute's examination suggests mounting pressures on these organizations, including changing voter sentiment particularly among younger Americans and shifts in how political power operates in Washington. The Quincy Institute, a think tank focused on foreign policy alternatives, framed the question as one of long-term viability for groups that have anchored U.S. Middle East policy for decades.
title: Quincy Institute questions future of pro-Israel advocacy groups
